questions.stem_text:
When the Heisenberg uncertainty principle is applied to a quantum mechanical particle in
the lowest energy level of a one-dimensional box, which of the following is true?

options.A: Momentum is known exactly, but no information about position can be known.
options.B: Position is known exactly, but no information about momentum can be known.
options.C: No information about either position or momentum can be known.
options.D: Neither position nor momentum can be known exactly.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Neither position nor momentum can be known exactly.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following statements most accurately explains why the 1 H spectrum of 12 CHCl
3 is a singlet?

options.A: Both 35 Cl and 37 Cl have I = 0.
options.B: The hydrogen atom undergoes rapid intermolecular exchange.
options.D: Both 35 Cl and 37 Cl have electric quadrupole moments.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Both 35 Cl and 37 Cl have electric quadrupole moments.

questions.stem_text: Which one of the following statements is true:

options.A: Protons and neutrons have orbital and spin angular momentum.
options.B: Protons have orbital and spin angular momentum, neutrons have spin angular momentum.
options.C: Protons and neutrons possess orbital angular momentum only.
options.D: Protons and neutrons possess spin angular momentum only.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Protons and neutrons possess orbital angular momentum only.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is classified as a conjugate acid-base pair?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - H 3 O+ / H 2 O

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements about the lanthanide elements is NOT true?

options.A: The most common oxidation state for the lanthanide elements is +3.
options.B: Lanthanide complexes often have high coordination numbers (> 6).
options.C: All of the lanthanide elements react with aqueous acid to liberate hydrogen.
options.D: The atomic radii of the lanthanide elements increase across the period from La to Lu.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The atomic radii of the lanthanide elements increase across the period from La to Lu.
